name: node-cli
description: A command-line tool in plain Node.js (ESM, no build step, no runtime dependencies to start with), shipped as an npm package. Tests with node:test, coverage thresholds as a ratchet, acceptance on the packed and installed package. No deployed site, no database.
$comment: scripts/apply-preset.mjs removes every path in `remove` (the web preset's own files) and then copies `files/` over the repository root. Everything else (loop/, .claude/, docs skeletons, the shared scripts) stays.
